desc: Formalize the orientation model: y_i for cycle edges, x_i for hub edges, d_i = c_i + x_i, d_N = m - sum x_i; answer = count of distinct (d-vector, k) pairs.
Characterize achievability of candidate d-vectors via 2-state transition relation on (y_{i-1}, y_i).
Design distinct-counting DP via subset construction (determinized 2-state NFA, 3 reachable subset states), bijection between d-vectors and subset paths.

Prove/brute-verify per-path interval property: achievable k = sum x_i forms contiguous interval [base, base+amb], each path contributes amb+1 tuples; verified exactly for all N<=8, all s patterns, against exhaustive orientation enumeration (incl. sample 1 = 14).
Derive and implement O(N) DP over 3 subset states tracking (path count, amb sum); answer = total_count + total_amb mod 998244353.
Handle cyclic wrap-around: start subset {0,1} (free y_{N-1}), accept non-empty final subset.
Write final Python solution with fast I/O, O(N) time, O(1) memory, mod 998244353; includes --selftest brute checker.
